verdict.rationale: The Wyoming SOS documents a sanctioned registered-agent rail. It provides forms to appoint or change an entity's registered agent and a Commercial Registered Agent registration for agents representing more than 10 companies, and it lists a UCC/EFS e-filing system for 'Authorized Users.' The evidence is only form and link titles, though, with no description of what an agent or provider may actually file or do on the company's behalf. Missing for 10: documentation of the scope of agent or provider authority to act or file for the company, any delegated account-access or designee mechanism for the authenticated WyoBiz portal, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
